data.body_html:
Formula 1 and Marbella: two worlds that collide in a weekend of speed, glamour, and Mediterranean sun. If you want to watch the Grand Prix from a front-row seat on the water, a Marbella yacht charter for the F1 weekend is the way to do it. Gather up to 12 friends, bring your own screen or stream the race, and let a professional skipper handle the rest. From Puerto Banús, you'll have the best view of both the race and the coastline.

Why charter a yacht for the F1 weekend in Marbella?

Marbella is a natural base for F1 parties. The city buzzes with events, but nothing beats the exclusivity of a private boat. You avoid crowded bars, control the music and drinks, and can anchor off Cala del Faro or Cabopino while the race plays on your tablet. The sea breeze keeps things cool, and the scenery—La Concha mountain, the Golden Mile, the marina—adds a backdrop no grandstand can match.

Our fleet for the F1 weekend

We have over 15 boats available, all departing from Puerto Banús. For a group of 12, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) or Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) are ideal. Smaller groups can take the Pershing 46 (14m, 10 pax) or Fairline Targa 12m (12m, 10 pax). Every charter includes a skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and IVA.

Pricing for the F1 weekend

Prices are fixed for two tiers. Tier A (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39): €749 for 2 hours, €2,299 for 8 hours. Tier B (Mangusta 80 white or grey): €4,719 minimum 4 hours, with a free jet ski included. For all other boats, pricing is on request via WhatsApp—no hidden fees, just a clear quote.

What's included on every charter

  • Licensed skipper (English & Spanish speaking)
  • Fuel for the full charter duration
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks (crisps, nuts, olives)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21% VAT)

How to watch the F1 race on board

Most yachts have a TV screen. You can connect your laptop or phone via HDMI or stream wirelessly. If your boat doesn't have a TV, bring a tablet or phone with a good data plan. The Mediterranean sun can cause glare, so position the screen in the shade. The skipper can help with setup.

Best spots to anchor during the race

Anchor near Puerto Banús itself for a lively atmosphere, or head to Cabopino for a quieter spot. Cala del Faro and Cala Cortés offer calm waters. If you want to combine the race with a swim, stop at the Río Verde area. All are within 20 minutes of the marina.

What else to do on the F1 weekend

Besides the race, Marbella offers beach clubs, fine dining, and nightlife. Book a sunset cruise after the race, or extend your charter to include a visit to Estepona or Sotogrande. Our Marbella yacht charter page has the full fleet and booking details.

How to book

Contact us on WhatsApp for availability. For Tier A and Mangusta 80 boats, you can book directly online. For other boats, we'll send a custom quote within minutes. The F1 weekend books out fast, so reserve early to secure your preferred yacht.
